description: The entropy count a signer displays after n rolls MUST NOT exceed floor(n * log2(6)). The expected ceiling is computed in exact integer arithmetic as the largest k with 2^k <= 6^n, so floating point cannot round it up. Cases include the counts where n * log2(6) lies closest below an integer, where a floating-point floor is most likely to overstate.
